blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A total of 202 new police recruits of the Police Regional Office-13 (PRO-13) formally took their oath of office on Wednesday, marking the start of their journey as members of the Philippine National Police (PNP) under the 2026 Attrition and Regular Recruitment Program. PRO-13 director Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon administered the oath during a ceremony held at Camp Col. Rafael C. Rodriguez in Barangay Libertad, Butuan City, following the presentation of the recruits by the chief of the Regional Recruitment and Selection Unit 13.
